newsitem.title: USA: CIPSCO unit files $170 mln bonds shelf.
newsitem.headline: CIPSCO unit files $170 mln bonds shelf.

text.p: Central Illinois Public Service Co, a unit of CIPSCO Inc, said Friday it filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $170 million in first mortgage bonds or medium term notes.
When combined with previous registration, Central Illinois will have a total offering of $200 million in bonds or notes available for sale.
Net proceeds will be used to redeem, refund, refinance, purchase or pay at maturity certain indebtedness of the company and for general corporate purposes, the filing said.

Central Illinois, organized in 1902 and based in Springfield, Illinois, is a public utility operating company engaged in the sale of electricity and natural gas in portions of central and southern Illinois.
CIPSCO Inc is currently the owner of all of the outstanding common stock of the company. Central Illinois is its utility subsidiary.
